arguments.objective:
Implement a dependency-free Node.js ESM inventory CLI in the shared workspace. Create cli.mjs, lib/store.mjs, and lib/inventory.mjs. The immutable contract is in acceptance/inventory.md and the frozen acceptance/inventory.test.mjs. Never edit acceptance/ or any test file. No reference implementation is present.

Implement the complete contract: item registration, stock receipt, reservation, release, shipment, aggregate reporting, strict identifiers and quantities, JSON persistence, and unchanged storage after rejected commands. Correctness across state transitions matters more than short code. Do not access another experiment workspace.

Use at most five fresh rounds. Do not stop after a partial feature set. Every test role or official worker must run the full suite with `TODO_CLI="$PWD/cli.mjs" node --test --test-reporter=tap acceptance/inventory.test.mjs`, report the actual pass/fail counts and exit code, and inspect the failures before continuing. Never filter or alter tests. The Custom host independently runs the same suite after its test child. Return complete only when the unchanged full suite passes; assertion failures are work to repair, not infrastructure blockers.
